final_text:
I would not extend this box, and I would leave it on today’s outbound manifest and release that manifest by 13:30.

There is no written duty-manager permission on the record. The 11 October note is only a request, and a pending request is not permission. A collection booking also does not change the storage date or take a box off the manifest. Operators cannot grant discretionary extensions, and this morning’s instruction was to make none this cycle and to release the full batch on time. The manager cannot approve today, and permission given tomorrow would not cover a date change made now.

I would mark the record reviewed, including those contact notes, and release the box with the other 59. Holding the manifest, or moving this box to reserve without a registered approval, would break the release rule and the extension rule.
